_note: Live experiments and their Smartlead parent campaigns. Subsequences are found by parent_campaign_id at run time (their names are unreliable). Update this file when an experiment launches, stops or gets a new arm. threshold = leads per arm/segment. Benchmarks with first_e1_from/to are cohorts: only leads whose first Email 1 was sent in that window count. Default No-HM benchmark is us_oj_nohm_historic (Gaston 2026-10-29: compare to the historic baseline, not the same time period). For step tests use its step rates (Oct 29: Email 2-3 add 0.29%, Email 3 alone 0.07%).

nohm_presplit.label: No-HM Routing CTA, pre-split cohort
nohm_presplit.why: 3804786's population changed on 2026-09-02/04 (CEO/founder <50 emp stays, everyone else goes to Exp 12). Use the pre-split cohort for Exp 12/13 and any No-HM persona test.

nohm_since_aug24.label: No-HM Routing CTA, leads since Aug 24
nohm_since_aug24.why: Step-level comparison for 008A/008B (Email 2-3, Email 3 alone). Directional: population changed Sep 2.

nohm_concurrent_oct22.label: Other No-HM campaigns, same window (Routing CTA + EXP-012, first Email 1 since Oct 22)
nohm_concurrent_oct22.why: For HireBase (a lead-source test): same weeks, same No-HM motion, leads from LinkedIn OJ / Apollo. Directional: copy and personas differ (Routing CTA is CEO/founders <50, Exp 12 is role copy; HireBase is the Candidate-led angle).

hm_baseline.label: HM baseline (EXP006 Baseline, B inboxes)
hm_baseline.why: For 011 (CEOs added on HM jobs). Different persona, so directional.

us_oj_nohm_historic.label: US OJ No-HM historic baseline (all baseline / Candidate-led / Routing CTA campaigns, A+B)
us_oj_nohm_historic.why: Gaston's benchmark (2026-10-29) for Apollo, HireBase and Exp 12. 2026-10-29 pull: 101,373 contacted, 2.81% actual replies, 789 positives (0.78%), 123 booked (0.12%). Excludes Weekend Angle 3621298 and +50 DMU Baseline 3474391. Rates fell over time: Nov-Jun 'All openings' A/B 0.98% pos, 0.14% booked; Jun 30+ campaigns 0.52% pos, 0.10% booked. Not Qualified only exists since 2026-08-05.

us_oj_hm_all.label: All US Open Jobs HM campaigns (16, A+B)
us_oj_hm_all.why: Gaston 2026-10-29: compare EXP-011 CEOs to all HMs, not one campaign. 2026-10-29 pull: 25,301 contacted, 2.55% positive, 0.32% booked.

experiments.name: Personalized Email 2 and Email 3
experiments.tests: Whether personalized Email 2-3 beats the baseline follow-ups on No-HM open jobs.

experiments.name: Adding Email 4 through Email 7
experiments.tests: Whether four extra follow-ups (Email 4-7) add positives worth the send capacity and the extra DNC/Not Interested replies.

experiments.name: CEO multi-role savings message
experiments.tests: Whether a multi-role savings message gets CEOs to reply positively.
experiments.status: stopped 2026-10-06 (archive once in-flight leads finish Email 3)

experiments.name: Adding the CEO when we already know the Hiring Manager
experiments.tests: Whether emailing the CEO on HM open jobs adds positives the HM didn't give.
experiments.status: always-on (Gaston 2026-10-29): CEOs book like HMs (0.37% vs 0.32%) and only 1 of 11 CEO-positive companies also had a positive HM; scale it (e.g. MoltSets)

experiments.name: Different copy for Engineering, Sales/GTM and Marketing
experiments.tests: Whether role-group-specific copy beats the generic No-HM copy. 3,600 per segment.
experiments.status: winding down (Gaston 2026-10-29): all three segments are below the historic No-HM baseline; replace with heads-of-department copy and let in-flight leads run out

experiments.name: Recruiting leaders on No-HM open jobs
experiments.tests: Whether HR / recruiting leaders (carved out of Exp 12) reply positively when we don't know the Hiring Manager.
experiments.status: running (DRAFTED with 0 leads on 2026-10-13; ACTIVE by 2026-10-28)

secondary_benchmark.label: HR / Talent contacts in No-HM production campaigns (Jan 1 - Aug 20, 2026)
secondary_benchmark.source: near-outbound-analytics-agent/analysis/oj_nhm_functional_owner_2026/open_jobs_no_hm_functional_owner_2026_decision_report.md §5 (production, US+LATAM+Canada+Asia; CB = HubSpot entity-deduped; positives predate Not Qualified)
secondary_benchmark.why: Gaston 2026-10-29: the No-HM baseline mixes in founders/CEOs who convert far better, so HR sits below it regardless of copy. EXP-013 wins if it beats this HR/Talent baseline, even while below the No-HM baseline. Show both. Not pulled by pull_stats (static).

experiments.name: HireBase as a new open-jobs lead source
experiments.tests: Whether No-HM leads from HireBase-sourced open jobs (2-week trial, feed live Oct 22) reply and book like leads from our current sources (LinkedIn OJ + Apollo), so HireBase can add send volume.
